title: Independence of normalized integral coefficient presentations
statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a finite-dimensional coefficient field E over Q_ℓ with an embedding into the algebraic closure, a NativeGeometry, and a scheme T. Any two normalized CoefficientPresentations of E on T induce the same integral map from the completed integral coefficient sheaf to the native coefficient sheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientPresentation_integralMap_eq [G : NativeGeometry.{u} l]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] PadicAlgCl l) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (C D : CoefficientPresentation l T E i) :
    C.integralMap l T = D.integralMap l T
